snippet.title: Tidy Up Ltd. – Official Trailer | Co-op Tidying Game for 1–8 Players 🧹✨ #tidyupgame #indiegame
snippet.description:
Someone made a mess, and it's your job to clean it up! ✨🧹

In Tidy Up Ltd. you run a magical tidying company. Take on jobs from fantasy clients and put wrecked shops back in order: alone or in online co-op for 1–8 players.

🏰 From a little wizard's shop to a great dwarven fortress
📦 Grab wares, shelve them where they belong, sweep up and set the furniture right
🪄 Learn spells: call wares into your hand, let them fly home, seek out every last one
🌙 Every job a new twist: night shifts, bewitched wares, no magic allowed
⚒️ Grow your company with gear, spells and outfits

Grab your friends and tidy up! Tidy Up Ltd. is out now on Steam.

#tidyupgame #cozygames #indiegame #coopgames #steam
